text.p: SME - Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar and his Hungarian counterpart Gyula Horn are not expected to sign any treaties during their meeting on August 15 in Hungary.
- Postova Banka, owned by state-run companies, posted profit of 16 million crowns in the first half of this year. The bank's balance sheet totalled 13.6 billion crowns at the end of June.
- Hygienic paper producer, Harmanecke Papierne, posted a profit of 68.1 milllion crowns in the first half of 1997.

PRAVDA - The paper quotes unnamed sources as saying the government is preparing a new plan on motorway construction which should delay the completion of scheduled projects by several years and boost expenditures by some 42 billion crowns.
- Minister of Agriculture Peter Baco said he expected 1997 grain production to exceed Slovakia's consumption needs and that some exports of Slovak grain were possible later this year.
- Interior Minister Gustav Krajci will be questioned on August 14 in the case of his alleged attempts to thwart referendums on NATO membership and direct presidential elections last May.
- Turnover tyre producer Matador Puchov totalled 5.5 billion crowns in the first half of 1997, with sales hitting 3.4 billion crowns.
- Private airline SK AIR has inaugurated a new route between the Czech city Brno and the eastern Slovak city Kosice.

NARODNA OBRODA - Trade unions at the state-owned public transport company in Svidnik, eastern Slovakia, said they would start an indefinite strike on Friday if management does not approve demanded changes. The unions area asking for an improvement of working conditions and a 12-percent pay increase.
- Sugar prices have been gradually falling in Slovakia due to a continuing surplus of the commodity over the past year.
- Telenor has offered to provide the official Slovak Television (STV) with digital satelite broadcasting of its second channel over the next five years at a cost of around 43 million crowns a year.
- STV's debt to Slovak Telecom for transmission of its signals now total some 150 million crowns. The debt is expected to increase to around 300 million crowns by the end of this year.
- State-owned Slovak Telecom posted a net profit of 2.56 billion crowns in 1996, some 715 million crowns more than in the previous year.

SLOVENSKA REPUBLIKA - The government is expected to discuss an unspecified amendment to the banking law during its regular session on Tuesday. The preliminary agenda does not include any other major economic items.
